clips.title: The story
paras: Brave Moonhorn is a tauren scout stationed at the top of the Great Lift on the southern border of the Barrens. From this precipice, he keeps watch over the entry to Thousand Needles and alerts travelers to the local dangers ahead.

Perched above the sheer drops of Thousand Needles, Brave Moonhorn stands guard where the northern plains meet the canyonlands. His primary role is keeping watchful eyes on regional threats moving through the canyon floor below, particularly the hostile centaur clans. Anyone looking to descend into the needles often crosses paths with him first, receiving crucial warnings before they step onto the massive platforms of the Great Lift.

Beyond the constant threat of roving centaur, Moonhorn harbors deep misgivings about his fellow tauren from the Grimtotem tribe. He cautions traveling Horde allies to keep their distance from them, noting their increasingly erratic and suspicious behavior around Thousand Needles. To ensure the defense of the region, he dispatches couriers to Freewind Post to deliver warnings to Cliffwatcher Longhorn.
